title: run.yipyap.reply.monitor.deregister.v1
description: Disable the monitor associated with this alert. Highest-blast-radius reply type, requires a separate per-channel explicit-trust flag. UI renders a warning banner when enabled.

alert_id.description: Alert ID. Used solely for ce_alertref validation; the handler derives monitor_id from the correlated outbound event.

monitor_id.description: The monitor to deregister. Must match the monitor referenced by the correlated outbound event's registry entry, cross-monitor deregister rejected.

reason.description: Justification required by the handler. Stored in audit log. Must be at least 16 characters, forces an intentional, documented action.
